source.name: CAGIS Open Data Hub ArcGIS FeatureServer: Hamilton_County_Parcel_Polygons
source.localRegistryEvidence: City of Cincinnati planning guidance links CAGIS Online and the CAGIS Open Data Hub; public parcel layer metadata identifies polygon geometry and OBJECTID.
source.schema: OBJECTID is the only requested field. Native source has additional fields, but no source-specific attribute set was retained.

requestOutcomes: Layer metadata GET succeeded anonymously; geometryType=esriGeometryPolygon.
Exact WUP point [39.1199188166246,-84.4875559123333] query returned zero features; treated strictly as an exact-point miss.
Nearby bounded extent query succeeded and returned parcel polygons; three full polygons retained in cincinnati-safe-sample.geojson, each with only properties.id equal to native OBJECTID.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax/account fields, or TLS exception used.
scopeLimits: A small extent sample is not citywide coverage or completeness evidence.
The exact point may fall outside a parcel polygon; zero exact-point results do not establish absence.
The service response indicated exceededTransferLimit for the extent; only the bounded three-record sample was retained.
No adapter was implemented or admitted; runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial review.

identityProvenance.reason: ArcGIS layer metadata declares OBJECTID as the object ID field; it is used as the stable native identity in the retained sample.

uncertainty: CAGIS and the open-data service are evidenced as a local public GIS source, but this packet does not independently establish update cadence or parcel legal completeness.
The service endpoint is ArcGIS-hosted and CAGIS-linked; source ownership/maintenance details beyond the cited public links were not inferred.
reviewerAction: Qualify any future adapter independently; do not treat packet completion as source integration/admission.
